aligned_slope.name: 开仓方向必须与中心线近两小时方向一致

local_trend.name: 近两小时也要走得顺，净移动至少占 30%

few_crossings.name: 近四小时穿越中心线不超过两次

strong_close.name: 突破那根顺向收盘，且收在有利一侧的四分之一

closer_entry.name: 离中心超过 1.25 倍宽度不追

no_spike.name: 突破那根振幅不超过先前常见振幅的 1.5 倍

active_market.name: 近期常见振幅至少占价格 0.25%

structure_break.name: 收盘还必须突破之前两小时的最高或最低价

plan.objective: User correction: investigate whether and when to enter. Profit protection is not the main question. Change only entry filtering; keep original exits.
frozen_rules: EMA(hl2,31) center, EMA(high-low,31) width, raw close crossing center +/-0.8 width, distance <=2 width, eight-hour efficiency >=20%.
For every candidate, profit protection fixed: activate at 2% favorable movement, allow 50% giveback; raw opposite signal independently exits even when new entry blocked.
One extra entry condition at a time; no combined filters, threshold sweep, altered stop/target, or delayed opposite exit.
Features only use signal candle or earlier completed bars; signal at close, trade next open. No current entry-candle high/low.
strong_close: bullish body and close in top quarter for long; bearish body and close in bottom quarter for short.
closer_entry: directional close-center distance <=1.25 current widths, versus baseline 2.
no_spike: signal candle high-low <=1.5 previous completed EMA31 range; do not normalize by a width that already includes the spike.
active_market: current EMA31 range / signal close >=0.0025.
structure_break: signal close > highest high of preceding eight bars for long; < lowest low for short. Excludes signal candle from lookback.
few_crossings: count changes in sign(close-center) over sixteen bars including signal close. Exact equality retains prior nonzero side.
Quarter tests start flat and force close at quarter end, capital compounds between quarters. Full two-year run is continuous. No costs or leverage.
plan.diagnosis: Annotate every original executed trade with pre-entry features. For each fixed filter show retained/rejected winning and losing counts and mean percentage outcome separately in first year and following year. These subsets are attribution, not complete filtered-strategy returns. Then rerun the actual strategy to include changed holding states.
plan.selection: Before later results: require first-year wins > losses, positive total return and >=50 trades. Rank return/drawdown then return then ID. None passing means no selection, never substitute retrospective winner.
plan.acceptance: Selected candidate must also have full and following-year wins > losses, following-year positive return and >=50 trades, and at least three quarters with positive return and at least three quarters with wins > losses. Failure does not prove all trend strategies impossible.
plan.limit: Only these nine versions, 54 simulations. No adding rules after viewing results. Preserve old studies. Any finding is an association or failure mode, not proof of an economic cause.
plan.caveat: All data previously seen; chronological split reduces direct selection leakage but is not untouched out-of-sample. Prior methods and screenshot fitting have already used the same market history.
